result.Method of Attack: Embedding malicious JavaScript code from compromised cdn.polyfill.io, redirecting mobile visitors to scam sites, injecting malware on mobile devices via any site embedding cdn.polyfill.io
Impacted Systems: npm packages relying on polyfill.io CDN
Attack Vector: Supply chain attack via compromised JavaScript CDN (cdn.polyfill.io)
Malicious code injection through third-party CDN scripts
Indicators of Compromise: Malicious JavaScript code delivered via cdn.polyfill.io
Redirects of mobile visitors to scam sites
Google alerts to advertisers about malicious scripts on landing pages
Sonatype Lifecycle and Repository Firewall flagging packages using cdn.polyfill.io
Domain redirecting to Cloudflare mirror (temporary mitigation)
